## Technical profile change
Describe what technical information is being added, removed or corrected.

## Public-information gate
- [ ] No precise location added
- [ ] No private contact information added
- [ ] No personal identifiers added
- [ ] No credentials/secrets added
- [ ] No production topology/internal endpoints added

## Evidence and accuracy
- [ ] Technical claims are supported by public code/specifications/tests
- [ ] Research/prototype status is explicit where needed
- [ ] Repository links resolve
- [ ] Public examples use synthetic/non-production data

## Architecture relevance
Explain which systems-engineering area this change improves: embedded, protocols, backend, distributed systems, observability, resilience, tooling or security.

## Review gate
Do not approve if the change increases personal exposure, publishes operational internals or introduces unsupported technical claims.
